scope: Static source references and provenance; not a live NASA API or live feed. No gameplay accounting is changed.
eligibility: NASA origin alone does not establish inclusion in the official challenge resource list or Global Award eligibility; verify current rules independently.
mediaCredit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio; Reto Stockli; NASA Earth Observatory; Terra/MODIS

sources.title: NASA Science — Moon: By the Numbers
sources.howUsedInProject: Lunar movement uses 1.62 m/s², rounded for gameplay. Earth gravity and lunar radius are context, not a physical scale guarantee.
sources.simplifications: Jump speed is adjusted to 2.4 m/s for accessible controls; terrain and biomechanics are fictional.

sources.title: NASA SVS — Blue Marble, Terra/MODIS
sources.howUsedInProject: A static NASA satellite-observation mosaic is used as the Earth texture. The institutional copy is science/earth.jpg.
sources.simplifications: Source PNG was converted to an RGB JPEG at the same resolution; game lighting is artistic. This is not live weather, live imagery or lunar terrain.

sources.title: NASA — Environmental Control and Life Support Systems

exactData.concept: Life support links air, water and waste systems; electrolysis uses water and power to generate oxygen and hydrogen.

sources.howUsedInProject: Inspires connected power, water, recycling and oxygen choices.
sources.simplifications: Rates, efficiencies and capacities are didactic gameplay hypotheses, not NASA-validated specifications.

sources.title: NASA — Hazard: Space Radiation

exactData.concept: Space radiation poses a risk to astronauts.

sources.howUsedInProject: Inspires the radiation and shelter challenge.
sources.simplifications: A deterministic storm and health model are fictional; no dose in sieverts or forecast is calculated.

sources.title: NASA Science — Protecting astronauts from space radiation at the Moon

exactData.concept: Solar particle events require radiation protection planning.

sources.howUsedInProject: Provides background for seeking shelter during a fictional event.
sources.simplifications: Game timing and protection are abstractions, not predictions or clinical protection estimates.

sources.title: NASA Science — VEGGIE

exactData.concept: Veggie studies plant growth in space.

sources.howUsedInProject: Inspires the crop and food challenge.
sources.simplifications: Growth time, irrigation and yield are game hypotheses, not NASA-validated rates; the greenhouse is fictional.

sources.title: NASA — What Is Microgravity?

exactData.concept: Orbiting spacecraft and occupants experience apparent weightlessness in free fall.

sources.simplifications: Movement is assisted on a plane; six degrees of freedom and full orbital physics are not simulated.

sources.title: NASA SVS — CGI Moon Kit / LRO LOLA

exactData.concept: LOLA measures lunar topography; derived maps are available for visualization.

sources.howUsedInProject: A possible future terrain reference only.
sources.simplifications: No LOLA map or measured digital elevation model is integrated; the terrain and canyon are authored fiction.
